channel.name: A&E CA
channel.title: Customer Wars
channel.desc: In Oakland, California, a customer holding up the line sparks an offensive verbal blowup with other customers; in Newport, Rhode Island, a public official and her friend resist as police attempt to remove them from a bar; in Canada, a group of BMX riders clash with mall security over bringing their bikes inside; in Raleigh, North Carolina, a delivery driver calmly walks through an active police standoff to complete a drop-off.
